_comment: Example of the manifest CapFrameX fetches from the URI configured as 'UpdateManifestUri'
in App.config. Serve it as application/json. Only 'version' and 'package.url' are required.
'package.url' may be relative - it is then resolved against the manifest URI.
Set 'package.sha256' (lower or upper case hex): when present the download is rejected unless
it matches, and the staged file is verified again before it is executed.
'package.arguments' is the command line handed to the installer; for the CapFrameX WiX
summary: Fixes PresentMon capture stalls and adds the new overlay layout editor.
highlights: Capture no longer stalls when a game loses focus
